# Zostaje

> Zostaje is a student-built budgeting and savings application in development. The primary website language is Polish; an English interface is available using the language selector.

## Product facts
- The current MVP is one offline iOS application, without sign-in, synchronization, telemetry or remote AI. Public installers are not available yet.
- It shows remaining money for today, this week and this month, using a starting balance and recorded operations. Missing entries affect the result; spending-pace status is not a guarantee of financial safety.
- Capture uses a quick form, a receipt photo (Apple Vision text recognition on device; the user reviews the amount) or a widget shortcut.
- User-created spaces keep their own balances and entries. Data is stored in a folder the user chooses.
- Split bills record participants and repayments. Marking a share returned neither transfers money nor automatically changes the balance.
- CSV import, recurring rules, bank integrations, synchronization and AI connections are outside the current MVP. Voice exists in the repository but is not a delivered MVP feature.
- The local app is intended to be free. Optional paid services are in development: Premium at PLN 39/month or PLN 397.80/year, and individually priced Founders Edition. See pricing for planned service scope.
- [Actual iOS screenshots](https://zostaje.com/) show a Polish development build, not public installer availability.

- Budgets is a separate module in development: virtual funds for existing money, user-confirmed income allocations, expense assignments and carry-over balances. Allocation does not execute bank transfers or create money.

- Spending-pace status compares recorded money against even spending over a calendar month. It does not include all future obligations and is not a guarantee of affordability.
- After a break, balance reconciliation updates the starting point but does not reconstruct missing transaction history.
- The vault is a user-selected folder. A chosen Files provider may synchronize that folder independently; Zostaje operates no cloud/sync service. The user is responsible for backups.
